purpose: Machine-checked inventory of every non-test outbound Canvas-mutation-shaped call under api/. Keyed by repo-relative path + qualified enclosing symbol + detector + call_index, never by line number. This file is the machine authority for docs/reference/mutation-reconciliation-map.md and for api/tests/test_canvas_mutation_ownership.py.

detector_legend.attr:<name>: an attribute call, e.g. requests.post(...) or canvas_client._canvas_send(...); <name> is the attribute (post/put/patch/delete/request/_canvas_send/canvas_send).
detector_legend.name:<name>: a bare-name call to an injected/imported callable literally named canvas_send or _canvas_send (dependency-injection parameter or direct import), not accessed via attribute.
detector_legend.alias:<verb>: a mutation-verb HTTP function referenced via assignment aliasing (e.g. http_post = requests.post) rather than called directly at that site.

call_index_note: 1-based occurrence index of the same (path, symbol, detector) triple, in source order. Distinguishes multiple calls of the same kind inside one enclosing symbol without using line numbers.

owners.call_form: canvas_client._canvas_send("PUT", path, request) [approved tiered-assignment update or publish]
owners.reason: Applies and verifies the exact reviewed tiered-assignment settings, including publishing unrestricted tier sources, before the operation completes.
The central operation-ledger post-apply hook invalidates applicable catalog scopes after the confirmed operation succeeds.

owners.call_form: canvas_client._canvas_send("PUT", <assignment_path>, request) [publish/date patch on an id-addressed existing assignment]
owners.reason: Patches only the caller-supplied published/due_at/unlock_at/lock_at fields of an existing assignment; description, points_possible, and assignment_group_id are never read or resent. The central operation-ledger post-apply hook invalidates catalog.assignments after the confirmed operation succeeds.
The central operation-ledger post-apply hook invalidates applicable catalog scopes after the confirmed operation succeeds.

File-upload init only. Spine 14.2 says uploads must never trigger a course-wide binary refresh; there is no evidence-record scope tracked for printable attachments, so 'none' here is the expected steady state, not a gap.

Per-student override write. The base override facts are not projected into the mirror at all; the only mirror footprint is the effective due date cached on the affected submission rows (private.submissions cached_due_date), read by the Student Report 'Due date extended to' line. Bounded, low-severity staleness (the report falls back to live Canvas outside the freshness window) — deferred for 1.0beta as a documented bounded limitation, not an open gap. See mutation-reconciliation-map.md family 3.

mirror_store.invalidate_late_policy(cid) is called immediately after a verified apply. This whole-scope stale-mark (not a precise merge) is why the state is 'invalidate' rather than 'targeted'.

owners.call_form: canvas_send("PUT", _path(session, user_id), payload) [raw score + optional comment]
owners.reason: The unified MCP Scoring Session submit path calls scoring_apply.apply_plan, which reaches this narrow grade writer. It sends the reviewed raw posted_grade and one plain-text comment once, then records the transport outcome; it performs no read-back and interprets no gradebook or late-policy adjustment. Canvas applies those adjustments itself.
